class.name: ChorusResult
class.brief_description: Immutable result of a history operation.
class.description: Immediate, read-only result of a conversation history operation. Check [member ok] before relying on the change. Failure does not emit [signal GodotChorus.generation_error].

members.member: Result code from [enum GodotChorus.ErrorCode]. Success is [constant GodotChorus.ERR_NONE].
Failure diagnostic, or an empty string on success.
Whether the operation succeeded. Equivalent to comparing [member error] with [constant GodotChorus.ERR_NONE].
